:::{#rem-ppv-prevalence}
#### The PPV depends on the population, not only on the test

The sensitivity and specificity describe the test's performance in a specified setting,
and may differ across settings
(for example, with the case mix of the people tested or the threshold used to call a result positive),
but the ratio $\frac{1 - \prev}{\prev}$ in @thm-ppv-sens-spec-prev
describes the population being tested.
When the disease is rare, that ratio is large,
so even a small false positive rate can make the PPV low,
as @exm-ppv-sens-spec-prev shows.

:::
